mapper.select: SELECT execution_id, user_id, conversation_id, source_message_id, scope_id, binding_id, status, version, (cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL) AS cancelled, completion_proposal_json, proposal_turn_id, proposal_hash, correction_count, recovery_attempts, answer_message_id, completion_protocol FROM sq_response_execution WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND binding_id=#{bindingId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT binding_id FROM sq_response_execution WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND execution_id=#{executionId} AND del_flag='0'
mapper.update: UPDATE sq_response_execution SET status=#{status}, version=version+1 WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND binding_id=#{bindingId} AND status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'PARTIAL', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED')

UPDATE sq_response_execution SET completion_proposal_json=#{json}, proposal_turn_id=#{turnId}, proposal_hash=#{hash} WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND binding_id=#{bindingId} AND completion_proposal_json IS NULL AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'RECOVERING')

UPDATE sq_response_execution SET status=#{status}, version=version+1, answer_message_id=#{answerId} WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND binding_id=#{bindingId} AND status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'PARTIAL', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED')

UPDATE sq_response_execution SET correction_count=correction_count+1, completion_proposal_json=NULL, proposal_turn_id=NULL, proposal_hash=NULL, status='QUEUED', version=version+1 WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND binding_id=#{bindingId} AND correction_count=0 AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL

UPDATE sq_response_execution SET recovery_attempts=recovery_attempts+1, status='RECOVERING', version=version+1 WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND binding_id=#{bindingId} AND recovery_attempts<2 AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'PARTIAL', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED')

UPDATE sq_response_execution SET cancel_requested_at=#{now}, status='CANCELLING', version=version+1 WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND binding_id=#{bindingId} AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'PARTIAL', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED')
UPDATE sq_command SET status='CANCELLED', delivery_token=NULL, delivery_lease_until=NULL WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND binding_id=#{bindingId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'DELIVERING')
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM sq_operation WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND scope_id=#{scopeId} AND status IN ('UNKNOWN', 'RECONCILING', 'IN_FLIGHT') AND del_flag='0' FOR UPDATE
SELECT kind FROM sq_interaction WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND scope_id=#{scopeId} AND status='OPEN' AND del_flag='0' FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sq_message(message_id, user_id, conversation_id, message_seq, role, content, completed, source_message_id, execution_id, occurred_at, creator_id, last_updater_id) VALUES(#{messageId}, #{userId}, #{conversationId}, #{sequence}, 'ASSISTANT', #{text}, TRUE, #{sourceMessageId}, #{executionId}, #{now}, #{userId}, #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT command_id FROM sq_command WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND binding_id=#{bindingId} AND action IN ('MESSAGE_SUBMIT', 'SUBMIT') AND status IN ('DELIVERED', 'APPLIED') AND native_turn_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT binding_id FROM sq_response_execution WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'PARTIAL', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED') ORDER BY id
SELECT completion_protocol FROM sq_response_execution WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND binding_id = #{bindingId} AND del_flag = '0'

SELECT r.completion_protocol FROM sq_response_execution r JOIN sq_runtime_binding b ON b.user_id = r.user_id AND b.binding_id = r.binding_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND b.framework_session_id = #{sessionId} AND r.del_flag = '0' AND b.del_flag = '0'

SELECT r.user_id AS userId, r.conversation_id AS conversationId, r.execution_id AS executionId, r.source_message_id AS sourceMessageId FROM sq_response_execution r JOIN sq_runtime_binding b ON b.user_id = r.user_id AND b.binding_id = r.binding_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND b.framework_session_id = #{sessionId} AND r.completion_protocol = 'NATURAL' AND r.cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND r.status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'PARTIAL', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED')

SELECT b.user_id, b.task_id, b.binding_id, b.agent_id, b.framework_session_id, b.native_event_cursor FROM sq_response_execution r JOIN sq_runtime_binding b ON b.user_id = r.user_id AND b.binding_id = r.binding_id WHERE r.cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL AND r.status IN ('CANCELLING', 'RECONCILING') AND b.binding_id > #{afterBinding} ORDER BY b.binding_id LIMIT 20
